_comment: LOCK 4 OF 4, second copy. public/_headers covers Cloudflare Pages and
Netlify; this file covers Vercel. Both ship, because which host a concept
demo ends up on is decided after the build, and a lock that depends on
remembering to add it is not a lock.
THIS FILE MUST LIVE AT THE REPOSITORY ROOT. It was originally written to
public/vercel.json, which Astro copies to dist/vercel.json - and Vercel
reads its config from the repo root, never from the build output. Sat in
public/ it did nothing except serve our own config as a static asset at
/vercel.json, and the X-Robots-Tag header was silently not applied. The
Cloudflare equivalent is the opposite: _headers IS read from the output
directory, so public/_headers is correct where this would not be.
Matches the six directives in the robots meta tag and in _headers exactly.
If one of the three ever changes, change all three.

headers.value: noindex, nofollow, noarchive, nosnippet, noimageindex, notranslate
